source_video_path: data/videos/GoPro Awards_ Haunting FPV Drone Flight Through Abandoned Building.mp4

relative_sharpness_measure.method: variance of 4-neighbor grayscale Laplacian; compare only within adjacent frames, not an absolute blur threshold

selection_rationale: Frame 1096 is two frames after the requested nearest frame 1094; it retains the same interior composition, shows no obvious motion smear on visual inspection, and has the highest relative Laplacian-variance score in the 11-frame window. The score is comparative only and does not prove absolute sharpness.
